section.p: Consider a Heading 2 called "Install on Linux," where the body contains a numbered list indicating a step-by-step procedure. This is a classic installation instruction.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Install on Linux [List Number]: 1. Download the installer. [List Number]: 2. Run the setup wizard. [List Number]: 3. Restart the service.

entry.codeblock: <task id="install_on_linux"> <title>Install on Linux</title> <taskbody> <steps> <step> <cmd>Download the installer.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Run the setup wizard.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Restart the service.</cmd> </step> </steps> </taskbody> </task>

section.p: Result: The converter classifies "Install on Linux" as a task topic because the title clearly indicates an action, and a numbered list is the primary body content. Each numbered item maps to <step><cmd> inside <steps>.
